parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen part of the display, made primarily of glass with a flat rectangular shape.
parts.Functional_description: The screen displays visual output from the computer or connected device, serving as the main interface for viewing content.
parts.Movement_description: The screen is fixed in position relative to the base and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the display, made of aluminum, providing structural support and stability.
parts.Functional_description: The base supports the screen and maintains the display’s upright position on a flat surface.
parts.Movement_description: The base is stationary and does not move, though it may allow for slight tilt adjustments depending on design.
